questions.stem: How has DNA analysis changed the way scientists classify organisms?

options.text: It has made classification less accurate
It allows scientists to compare genetic similarities and reclassify organisms more accurately
It has confirmed that all previous classifications were correct
DNA analysis cannot be used in classification

questions.explanation: DNA analysis allows scientists to compare the genetic sequences of different organisms directly. This has led to some organisms being reclassified when their DNA showed they were more or less closely related than previously thought.
